items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: He’s an amazing person, him and his wife, Donna.

ctx.x: That was it, it was a challenge. And so everything went very greatly with Lalo and then for the past ten, fifteen years Lalo calls me regularly and we became good friends. We still communicate. He’s an amazing person, him and his wife, Donna. But if I mention him before Michel, because if I had not worked —
